notes: VERIFIED 2026-07-06 against raw HTML of becomepresent.mystrikingly.com (582KB, fetched via Wayback Machine id_ raw endpoint to bypass the live WAF) plus live CloudFront/WAF behavior of quinntonharris.mystrikingly.com via curl. DETECTION (all confirmed in raw HTML): (1) hosting subdomain *.mystrikingly.com. (2) NO <meta name=generator> (empty is correct). (3) meta tags: <meta name="strikingly-host-suffix" content="strikingly.com">, <meta name="asset-url" content="https://static-assets.strikinglycdn.com">, <meta name="support-helper" content='{"permalink":"becomepresent","id":12431891}'>. (4) <body class='show locale-en' id='user_sites' theme_name='s5-theme'>. (5) containers id="s-page-client-container", id="s-content" (class "s-variation-default ... s-template-s5-theme ... s-site-page-content"), id="s-footer-section-container", id='s-support-widget-container'. (6) Hypernova SSR: data-hypernova-key="SiteBootstrapper", data-hypernova-id, data-hypernova-emotion-id, plus data-emotion + data-react-style. RENDER: React server-rendered via Airbnb Hypernova + Emotion, then hydrated; full page content is in the raw HTML so a mirror can scrape without JS (needsHydrationCheck=false). jQuery 3.7.1 loaded from cdnjs.cloudflare.com; Strikingly bundles under static-assets.strikinglycdn.com/webpack use hashed names (detectIE-<hash>.js, i18n-<hash>.js, page-site-bundle.<hash>.js, lightBoostedPage-site-bundle.<hash>.js). ASSETS: all five strikinglycdn.com subdomains confirmed present (custom-images, uploads, user-images = user assets; static-assets = JS/CSS; static-fonts-css = fonts). BADGE: 'Powered by Strikingly' is a Pro-removable footer feature; in raw HTML it appears only as (a) the footer <div class="... s-footer-section s-section show-strikingly-logo ...">, and (b) an inline LogoSeoData URL www.strikingly.com/?ref=logo&...&utm_campaign=footer_pbs&utm_medium=user_page&utm_term=pbs_b — the visible anchor is rendered on hydration, NOT static. badgeSelector #s-footer-section-container .show-strikingly-logo confirmed valid. ANTI-BOT: served via AWS CloudFront with an AWS WAF JS challenge (response 202, header x-amzn-waf-action: challenge, body loads awswaf.com/.../challenge.js and calls AwsWafIntegration.getToken()). A realistic browser UA does NOT reliably return 200 — it only passes intermittently on a CloudFront cache hit; a proper fetch must execute the WAF challenge JS / carry the aws-waf-token cookie. (Researcher's claim that a desktop UA returns 200 is only partly true.) Response headers Strikingly-Cache* and Set-Cookie __strk_* were NOT observable on the challenge responses, so treat them as plausible-but-unverified HTTP hints. Priority 85: *.mystrikingly.com is unambiguous dedicated hosting; for Pro custom domains, fall back to the strikingly meta tags + s-page-client-container/Hypernova SiteBootstrapper signatures.
corrections: Verified nearly every signature against a real Strikingly site's raw HTML (becomepresent.mystrikingly.com via Wayback id_ raw endpoint) and live WAF behavior (quinntonharris via curl).
